original_core: Five 96,639-param PAR-TIME-005 genuine 768-event trained TAC checkpoints; same SHA and code
source_dev_period: May–Jun 2014 previously exposed genuine sensor records, not independent
original_write_address: exact normalized core.address(frozen_stream_event_embedding), captured at source event before its queried later values
reference_address: 8D normalized [cos,sin] of source-observed event ordinal divided by four pre-registered distinct periods; source-legal index, no source numerical outcome
metrics: source writer key Gram effective rank 1..8, average absolute off-diagonal key cosine, same-site pairwise true-key cosine by source event lag
privacy_and_science: Source event keys are privileged analysis traces and NOT part of deployed constant-size state; no old target accessed in a query; per-lag writer-key diversity alone does not imply content retention or useful reconstruction.
